import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter,deque
# Pair 8: classify each added cell's relation to the nearest same-color source dot.
I=G['Demo pair 8 input']; O=G['Demo pair 8 output']
H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=7
src=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg]
added=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==bg and O[r][c]!=bg]
# For each source dot, set of (dr,dc) of added cells within chebyshev dist 2 whose color matches source
rel=Counter()
for sr,sc,col in src:
    srel=Counter()
    for ar,ac,v in added:
        dy=ar-sr; dx=ac-sc
        if abs(dy)<=2 and abs(dx)<=2 and v==col:
            srel[(dy,dx)]+=1
    rel[(col,tuple(sorted(srel.items()))[:1])]=len(srel)
# show per color the most common offsets
oc=Counter()
for sr,sc,col in src:
    srel=Counter()
    for ar,ac,v in added:
        dy=ar-sr; dx=ac-sc
        if abs(dy)<=2 and abs(dx)<=2 and v==col: srel[(dy,dx)]+=1
    oc[col]+=srel.most_common(4)
print(oc)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def show(I,O=None):
    bgo=Counter(v for row in I for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    if O is None: O=[row[:] for row in I]
    print('IN ','\n'.join(''.join('.' if v==bgo else str(v) for v in row) for row in I))
    print('OUT\n'.join(''.join('.' if v==bgo else str(v) for v in row) for row in O))
show(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'])
